backlog.goal: Prove rqlite distinct need vs existing local durability; wire only if non-duplicate.
Local-first project memory/checkpoint contract and restart isolation.
Do not infer destination; close only from literal authoritative destination or documented supersede.
Wire collector boundary without duplicating OpenTelemetry Python.
Materialize/evidence VM Manager capability selection or prove equivalent existing implementation.
Keep provider/runtime/hardware gaps separate; no mirror or guest-boot claim without evidence.
Research official compatible provenance only; motor remains immutable.
Promote only components with real Fables wiring + runtime test.
Continue 21-40 one component at a time; separate component failures from test infrastructure failures.
Use acquired Testcontainers only if CI host capability exists; prove a real adapter integration path.
Prove workspace/global recovery and failover beyond local durable ledger subgates.
Close each by proven REUSE equivalence or provider-compatible acquisition; do not force download.
Attach existing live policy lane evidence into final requirement matrix.
Keep product publish blockers separate from runtime closure and resolve with exact workflow/credential evidence.
Run final top-down/bottom-up coverage, reconstruction without chat and final E2E before VERIFIED_CLOSED.

known_completed_subgates: OPA/OpenFGA Fables-wired live runtime policy lane
global_closure_gate: G12 requirement→layer→file/function→test→evidence must reach 100%; Memory/Audit, Agent boundary, Integration/Consolidator, Sandbox/UEK/Recovery and platform routing must be implemented or closed by evidenced equivalence before final judge.
